Frequently Asked System Questions

Q: Can I submit my own guest post / devlog?
YES! I am always looking for fellow developers and historians to write about retro tech. Send me a pitch with your outline, and I'll check your specs.
Q: Where can I find the code for your projects?
All my active pipelines, game engines, and retro devops pipelines are hosted on my GitHub repository. Pull requests are welcome, hero.
Q: How often are new quests published?
New devlogs and tutorials are released every alternate Tuesday. Subscribe to my Discord transmissions to get live ping alerts.
